profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Cohesity
profile.summary:
Graduated with MS in Software Engineering at San Jose State University in Dec 2018. 

Enthusiastic Software Developer worked on projects with Distributed Systems, Cloud Technologies, Test Automation, Web Development and willing to resolve challenges in most efficient manner.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed user interface for Integration Application, enabling real-time connectivity between external systems like WMS/ERP and fleet of mobile robots by consuming RestAPI’s and streams of data like server sent events.
•  Created test case flow and executed test cases in the automated test framework interacting with data channels like SQL and REST to uncover, identify and document software problems.
•  Continuous integration and continuous deployment using Jenkins and Bit Bucket.
Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Postgres, Jenkins, Bit Bucket, Jira, Debugging, IntelliJ

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
• Provide Customer Support by providing information and resolve queries.
• Update and maintain the research foundation website regularly.
• Maintaining documents using Microsoft Tools and writing articles for the website.

company.name: San José State University Research Foundation

projects.title: Prototype of Kayak.com
projects.description:
•  Delivered a multi-tier scalable web application used for booking flights, hotels and cars along with filter search.
•  Contributed in the user module by developing the front end React components for consuming RESTAPI’s, processing and populating data on the user interface.
Technologies: NodeJS, ReactJS, MySQL, MongoDB, Apache Kafka, Mocha

projects.title: Prototype of Dropbox Application (FullStack)
projects.description:
•  Developed replica of Dropbox, a multi-tier distributed service oriented application used for file storage and sharing.
•  Implemented Apache Kafka stream processing providing high scalability and increased throughput and tested it using Mocha.
Technologies: NodeJS, ReactJS, MySQL, Apache Kafka, Mocha, Postman
